ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 4-I in the area bounded by:

A line 101.00 feet north of West 18th Street along South California Avenue;
the alley next east of and parallel to South California Avenue;

a line 76.0 feet north of and parallel to West 18th Street;

and South California Avenue,

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 1651 South California Avenue, Chicago, IL 60608
